title: Being finite descends along fpqc coverings (Stacks 02LA)
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{g_i:S_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be an fpqc covering of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For $i\in I$ let $f_i:X\times_SS_i\to S_i$ be the base change of $f$ along $g_i$, the second projection of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $f_i$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] for every $i\in I$, then $f$ is finite.

source.place: Descent, Lemma Tag 02LA (lemma-descending-property-finite, line 6102: 'The property P(f) = "f is finite" is fpqc local on the base'), the direction 'each base change $X\times_SS_i\to S_i$ has the property $\Rightarrow$ $f$ has it' of 'fpqc local on the base', Descent, Definition Tag 02KO (definition-property-morphisms-local, line 5310)

proof.text: *Each $f_i$ is integral and locally of finite type.* For every $i\in I$ the morphism $f_i:X\times_SS_i\to S_i$ is finite by hypothesis, hence integral [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] by the direction 'finite $\Rightarrow$ integral and locally of finite type' of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-iff-integral-lft].

source.place: Descent, proof of Lemma Tag 02LA (line 6107): 'A finite morphism is the same thing as an integral morphism which is locally of finite type', Morphisms, Lemma Tag 01WJ (morphisms-lemma-finite-integral, morphisms.tex line 11022)

proof.text: *$f$ is integral.* The family $\{g_i:S_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ is an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering] and every base change $f_i$ of $f$ along $g_i$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is integral (step 1), so $f$ is integral by [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-descend-integral].

source.place: Descent, proof of Lemma Tag 02LA (lines 6110-6112), Lemma Tag 02L9 (lemma-descending-property-integral, line 6087)

proof.text: *$f$ is locally of finite type.* Likewise every $f_i$ is locally of finite type (step 1), so $f$ is locally of finite type by [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-descend-locally-finite-type].

source.place: Descent, proof of Lemma Tag 02LA (lines 6110-6112), Lemma Tag 02KX (lemma-descending-property-locally-finite-type, line 5737)

proof.text: *$f$ is finite.* By steps 2 and 3, $f$ is integral and locally of finite type, hence finite by the direction 'integral and locally of finite type $\Rightarrow$ finite' of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-iff-integral-lft].
